summary.text: Steven Rudy is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 1 since 2005 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has served as House Majority Leader since 2022 and is part owner of Rudy's Farm Center.

paragraphs.text: Steven Rudy's professional experience includes working as owner of Rudy's Farm Center.
He took office in the Kentucky House in 2005 and began serving as House Majority Leader in 2022.
In 2019-2020 he chaired the House Appropriations and Revenue Committee, and for 2025-2026 his committee assignments were Banking and Insurance, Committee on Committees, Enrollment and Rules.
The Republican primary for his seat on May 19, 2026, was canceled.
